quote_text: So our story begins in 1998 A youngster Who was just supposed to take over,   his father business, who had started cricket just because his father wanted him to. That youngster was gone play for India today. at the age of 17. This was to be his opportunity to make his mark, to make his father proud, to make his family happy..... and in just the fourth match that he played, he gets reported by the match referee. Yup, that’s a young Harbhajan Singh Challenging Ponting, in just his 4th international ODI match…. Rude, brash and disrespectful Those were the words that were used… when a 1 match ban was imposed on the youngster Along with a hefty fine…. but, within 3 months of this fine another word would be added to this description. Chucker. Harbhajan had been reported  for suspect action It would take 5 more months and minor action correction before he could get back into the team… But when he did, The youngster had become the one  thing, that the Indian team did not need He had become average The magic seemed to have dissapered and soon, he was kicked out of the team… They tried to give him a chance though…. shortlisting him for the first batch of the newly minted National Cricket Academy, He was to be trained under the tutelage of  Prasssana and Venkatraghvan, two legends of Indian spin… but within a few  week of his entry…. He was expelled The Reason…. Well, you guessed it, disrespectful & unpunctual behavior. but this time, it seemed like bhajji had crossed a li The selectors had been enraged to the point that many a times, bhajji was told - point blank "You are done". "Your Cricketing career is over". No selector was ever gone vouch for him again… His sponsorship job with Indian  Airlines was also put on review Even his spot, in the Punjab Ranji team was being called into question… and as if to provide the final punch, his last pillar of support the  reason he was playing cricket, his father, passed away. So, we have a 20 year old, reported and thrown out of the national side, kicked out of NCA, blacklisted by the selection committee. who is now desperately searching for a way to support his 5 sisters and his mother…. In short, the youngster was done, with his only legacy being the words. Rude ,Brash & Disrespectful but, call it fate call it luck, or just god's plans there was a captain, who was desperately looking for those exact words. Saurav Ganguly… Thrust into captaincy at the aftermath of the match fixing scandal, He had been himself been facing, storm after storms in his captaincy Even his ascension to captaincy had been fraught with furious board room battles and political quagmire. It’s an interesting story by itself, So do message me in the comments if anybody wants to know But finally nabbing the captaincy by a very thin margin… He had went onto lose All the Multi Nation Tournament. That included one to Sri Lanka one to new Zealand and two to Pakistan. The second time Pakistan won India had even failed to even make  it to the Asia cup Finals. So, The captaincy was in trouble, & on top of that soon coming to Indian shores were the world champions, Australia On a 16 wins win streak, as if to add insult to injury Kumble had been out due to shoulder injure Dada had tried out 3 different  spinners in the last few months. All of whom had failed miserably. Fate seemed ready to put the  final nail in Dada’s captaincy and in a final bid of desperation, Ganguly along with the newly  appointed coach John Wright, asked for 25 probable candidates who would be tested in a conditioning camp in Chennai. Among those 25, was an improbable youngster called Harbhajan Singh Later it would be known that the only reason he was actually selected was that an official from the Punjab Cricket Association had taken pity on the boy who had lost his father This was to be the last favor he  would do for the unfortunate boy, but that boy, He had his own plans For the last few months, shocked awake by this father's death, with his family now completely dependent on him. Bhajji had to make a choice On one hand - he could go to Canada To work as a Truck Driver Or try his failing luck - here in India His family or his Father He made his Decision "My father wanted me to be a cricketer, So for him, I will give this one last try, One last try with every fiber of my being." So, On the ground he was batting, balling, fielding, doing everything that was required of him, that was followed by stamina training and ending in a flurry of practice balls, till he got it exactly right. The right height, the right length, the right spin, and the right bounce on and on he went…moth after month and in the training camp, it showed, The coach John Wright's eyes couldn't move away from the 20 year old. Later, he would go on to say that what amazed him was the sheer bounce bhajji could generate The coach quickly contacted Ganguly & inform him of this newly found gem… Ganguly on his end dug into the youngsters records, finding reasons after reasons after  reasons to refuse the youngster. All of which made ganguly want him more. because  quite frankly Harbhajan reminded Ganguly of himself. Just like Harbhajan Gangaly had switched from football to cricket, to make his father happy Just like Bhajji, he had a relatively short domestic career before being catapulted into the Indian team and just like Harbhajan after his debut He had been blacklisted and thrown out of the Indian team… the reason? his Attitude, his Arrogance Later, Ganguly would go on to say , that he had just fallen victim to the political battles in the Bengal Cricket Association. The same political wranglings that had kept Ganguly out the the Indian team for the next 4 years it would take repeated stellar performances in domestic circuits along with an enraged Sidhu abandoning a tour midway that would finally Ganguly would get a chance an opportunity that Ganguly held on with a mad zeal, slowly and gradually climbing on to the top of Indian cricket. There was no way Captain Ganguly would allow somebody else to suffer the way he had done, especially someone who was punished for not having good behavior good behavior accordingly to Ganguly had no place outside of a school when you are on the pitch you should do everything and anything to win & looking at the young Sardar bowing. He seemed hungry enough to kill anyone standing in his way so, straightway He asked Harbhajan’s name to be added to the warm up match of India A against Australia in nagpur giving the simple excuse, Harbhajan has faced Australians before The experience may give him an edge… and it took just a few hours for The India A captain Laxman to be captivated by the youngster. Standing in the slips, he could see the bounce  and  drift that Bhajji was generating, salivating at the prospects that it could bring On lunch, when he got a call from Ganguly about how the players were doing, inspite of Rahul Sanghvi taking 5 wickets in the first innings Laxman couldn’t stop gushing about Harbhajan. In response, Dada had a simple sentence "Don’t give him any more bowling. I don’t want the Australians to see too much of him". The decision was done for Dada. He would get Bhajji into his team by hook or by crook. The funny thing is Bhajji was furious at Laxman’s decision to bench him. That It took Laxman explaining to him, Dada's decision to calm him down… and So, while Bhajji cooled off, Dada got ready for an uphill battle. The selection committee had made it's intentions clear. For the first match They wanted the recent performer Rahul Sanghvi along with Sarandeep Singh in the team and so it started Ganguly went explained the coaches and Laxman's recent  observation on the young sardar Further stating that repeated failures of the same spinners over the last one year. Then he showed the relative  inexperience of the bowling lineup, what Ganguy didn’t know at the time was that soon enough, he was to lose whatever experience that he had Srinath would be injured in the first match, Agarkar would come down with fever, Sanghvi would be dropped after the first test, as would Venkatapathy Raju and Venkatesh Prasad. By the third test…the bowling lineup would be Harbhajan with 10 tests, a young Zaheer khan with 3, Nilesh Kulkarni with 2 and Sairaj Bhautale on debut Things were so bad that bowling would be opened by Zaheer khan and Saurav Ganguly Anyways, After the Initial proposal what followed was a tug of war between the selection committee and team management Both sides adamant on their view refusing to budge The meeting would go well into the night with Ganguly finally emerging victorious.. But in doing so, he had spent nearly all of the political capital Being well aware of the fact, that with the world cup, 2 years away, Any changes to the captaincy would have to be done right now to be effective…. Hence, this series would might as well become Dada’s last. Win and hold on to your captaincy or lose…and losen everything… Dada had mortgaged his entire future to get this one opportunity for an abandoned youngster…. Win or lose, They would be on the same boat And so, started the First test. Let me rephrase… So, started the first massacre. A three day massacre A massacre in which Australia had decided to bowl first and face the fourth inning. Something that had happened just three times on the Indian sub-continent And yet, not only did they defeat India, They humiliated us at home. By the time Ganguly got out in the second inning, The ground was filled by a sea of boos, It seemed to be the funeral song of Ganguly’s Captaincy The only light in this debacle, was the abandoned youngster, who had taken 4 wickets in one inning... Come the second test, it would  feel like déjà vu Harbhajan taking wickets and India losing the plot BCCI insiders were muttering it might as well be that Ganguly had started the young man’s career. Literally, sacrificing his own But, then came the miracle, the miracle of Kolkata, the miracle of Dravid and Laxman batting through 1 and half day to save the test match for India. We have made a detailed video on that match if you wanna hear about it but for now that historic stand by itself would have been enough to make this test memorable… But what made this match legendary….. was what Harbhajan was about to do What looked easy seas under Dravid and Laxman was converted into a minefield under Harbhajan The captain had informed him "Just go and do whatever you want". I will do the rest In the fourth inning Australian collapse that Harbhajan effected… in this legendary match that India won. It was Ganguly…working in the background Setting the perfect traps for the youngster to exploit. Laxman would later go onto say … that what people see is Harbhajan’s magic, but what they didn't see is the smart set up, done by Ganguly around the bowler Ganguly knew that the Australians were going to take on Bhajji, So, from the outset he set out an in-and-out field, preventing the Australians from playing there favourite shots… or else doing so at the risk of there wicket… and while this trap was set into motion dada  would see something particular His aggressive actions, seemed to have a particular effect on his team's youngsters Whenever he picked a fight with australians, the youngsters together seemed to want to continue the fight on his behalf… So starting from the second innings, whenever he felt the team morale is going down. when they are about to lose the match He would purposely go to needle the Australians, Picking the fight, acting enraged … and then just sitting back, letting Zaheer and Bhajji do the rest. A perfect example of which came in the third match Chennai Day 4. it's the third inning & Australia is leading by 131 runs and Sharne Warne having just scored  39 runs India seems to be slowly, ball by ball, losing the match & by the time the last over of the day was abou tot be balled. Warne was surrounded by Laxman at slip. Das at forward short leg and Dravid at leg gully, and in walks Ganguly, at silly point without a helmet, in the next two balls as Warne defended for his life. Ganguly kept on poking at Warne, talking to him, Needling him, Challenging him… and on the last ball of the over, the Last ball to be balled that day. He calls up a fifth fielder to stand at gully. going and correcting his positioning,  again and again making Warne wait with anticipation and anxiety of the last ball building & so came the last ball Warne, seemingly scared by the  sheer number of bodies around him, pushed his leg out, way before the ball arrived, and then realizing his mistake. Instinctively, tried to take his leg back but the ball had reached its mark. Sharne Warne was out, on the last ball of the day, bowled by Harbhajan,  engineered by Ganguly. if you take the interviews of both of them even today. On one hand, you have Harbhajan saying, That dada backed me up when the whole world had turned there backs to me and dada on the other hand, y straightaway says,  "bhajji saved my captaincy….". Either ways though, one fact remains, on that summer of 2001, the streets of India, were filled with Amul ads, proudly stating, Har bhojan ke sangh, with every meal. In essence, cementing Bhajjis position in the Indian team for years to come… and Ganguly… having won the gamble of his captaincy, would go on to change the mentality of Indian cricket, asked about this gamble , years later, he would go on to say, that Leadership is an amazing disease. It either cures you or kills you, but if you can rise up to its challenges, prove yourself equal to its demand it is the best job in the world thank you for watching this video We have made numerous videos on that series Thank you for watching and i hope you have a good day.
title: When Ganguly Saved bhajjis Career and Harbhajan saved Dadas captaincy | India vs Australia 2001 Test
